INVITATION TO BID FOR ONE (1) UNIT BRAND NEW
TRAILER MOUNTED SHREDDER MACHINE FOR
SHREDDING BIODEGRADABLE / COMPOSTABLE WASTE
AND MRF OPERATIONS, MIAGAO, ILOILO
1. The Municipality of Miagao through the Budget for the Contract Approved by the
Sanggunian, Trust Fund - DENR, Budget Year 2018 intends to apply the sum of P
200,000.00 being the Approved Budget for the Contract (ABC) to payments under the
contract for One (1) Unit Brand New Trailer Mounted Shredder Machine for
Shredding Biodegradable / Compostable Waste and MRF Operations, Miagao, Iloilo.
Bids received in excess of the ABC shall be automatically rejected at bid opening.
2. The Municipality of Miagao now invites bids for the following:
ITEM
NO. QUANTITY | UNIT ITEM DESCRIPTION
1 1 unit | Brand New Trailer Mounted Shredder Machine
with the following specifications:
Output Capacity: 3500-4500 KGS/HR
Number of Blades and Cutter: 24 Pcs
Chamber made of MS Plate Gauge
Trailer mounted with brand new pneumatic tire:
#12 with wood chopper
Prime Mover: 10-12HP Electric Start Diesel Engine
with battery
AMTEC Tested
Delivery of the Goods is required thirty (30) calendar days after receipt of Notice to
Proceed. Bidders should have completed within twelve (12) months, a contract
similar to the Project from the date of submission and receipt of bids. The description
of an eligible bidder is contained in the Bidding Documents, particularly, in Section II.
Instructions to Bidders.
3. Bidding will be conducted through open competitive bidding procedures using a non-
discretionary “pass/fail” criterion as specified in the Implementing Rules and
Regulations (IRR) of Republic Act (RA) 9184, otherwise known as the “Government
Procurement Reform Act”.
